/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B -c 'from solution import patch_query
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit
cases = [
(\"/p?a=1&a=2&blank=&bare#frag\", [], [(\"a\",\"1\"),(\"a\",\"2\"),(\"blank\",\"\"),(\"bare\",\"\")]),
(\"/p?a=1&b=2&a=3\", [(\"a\",\"4\")], [(\"b\",\"2\"),(\"a\",\"4\")]),
(\"/p?a=1&b=2\", [(\"a\",\"x\"),(\"b\",None),(\"a\",\"y\"),(\"c\",\"\")], [(\"a\",\"y\"),(\"c\",\"\")]),
(\"/p?a=1&b=2\", [(\"a\", \"\"),(\"b\",None)], [(\"a\",\"\")]),
(\"/p?%61=1&A=2&a=3&x=4\", [(\"a\",None)], [(\"A\",\"2\"),(\"x\",\"4\")]),
(\"/p\", [(\"雪 &+%=\", \"café 雪 &+%=\")], [(\"雪 &+%=\", \"café 雪 &+%=\")]),
(\"../path?x=1#relative\", [(\"y\",\"2\")], [(\"x\",\"1\"),(\"y\",\"2\")]),
(\"https://user:pass@Example.invalid:123/a%2Fb?x=1#f%20?z\", [(\"x\",\"2\")], [(\"x\",\"2\")]),
(\"//Example.invalid/path?=blank&x=1\", [(\"\", \"new\")], [(\"x\",\"1\"),(\"\",\"new\")]),
]
for url, updates, expected in cases:
    result = patch_query(url, updates)
    before, after = urlsplit(url), urlsplit(result)
    assert (after.scheme,after.netloc,after.path,after.fragment) == (before.scheme,before.netloc,before.path,before.fragment), result
    assert parse_qsl(after.query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result
updates = [(\"a\", \"\"), (\"b\", None), (\"a\", \"last\")]
original = updates.copy()
assert patch_query(\"/p?a=old&b=2\", updates) == \"/p?a=last\"
assert updates == original
class OnePass:
    def __init__(self): self.used = False
    def __iter__(self):
        assert not self.used
        self.used = True
        yield \"a\", \"first\"
        yield \"b\", \"2\"
        yield \"a\", \"last\"
assert patch_query(\"/p?a=old\", OnePass()) == \"/p?b=2&a=last\"
assert patch_query(\"/p\", ((k,v) for k,v in updates)) == \"/p?a=last\"
assert patch_query(\"/p\", [(\"k\", \" +%&=雪\")]) == \"/p?k=+%2B%25%26%3D%E9%9B%AA\"
print(\"13 focused checks passed\")'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- solution.py; git status --short'
